page.layout: One scanned image: the front binding of a book (pigskin or vellum-style leather cover with blind-stamped ornamental border, three raised bands on the spine edge, and two metal clasp fittings on the right edge). No printed page text on this scan.
page.notes: Front cover of the binding, not a printed page. The blind-stamped frame and the dark ink stain/armorial-looking smudge at the centre are decoration or stains, not printed text. A faint blue pencil mark sits left of centre. No readable printed words, so nothing is transcribed. Clasp fittings and raised bands are physical features of the binding.
